signature: public static long Run(int[] left, int[] right)
semantic_contract: Return, as long, the number of left positions whose value occurs in right. Duplicates in left count separately. Both arrays are non-null. Do not mutate inputs. Empty left yields zero. Empty right contains no values.
bad: For every left position, scan right from index zero with a nested loop and a local found flag. Stop the inner scan on the first match, then add 1 when found. No hash sets, LINQ, sorting or auxiliary collections.
good: Construct one System.Collections.Generic.HashSet<int> from right. Visit every left position, query Contains, then add 1 when found. Do not deduplicate left. No LINQ.

signature: public static long Run(int[] left, int[] right)
semantic_contract: Return, as long, the number of left positions whose value does not occur in right. Duplicates in left count separately. Both arrays are non-null. Do not mutate inputs. Empty left yields zero. Empty right contains no values.
bad: For every left position, scan right from index zero with a nested loop and a local found flag. Stop the inner scan on the first match, then add 1 when not found. No hash sets, LINQ, sorting or auxiliary collections.
good: Construct one System.Collections.Generic.HashSet<int> from right. Visit every left position, query Contains, then add 1 when not found. Do not deduplicate left. No LINQ.

signature: public static long Run(int[] left, int[] right)
semantic_contract: Return the long sum of all left values that occur in right. Each matching left position contributes its value, including negative values and duplicates. Both arrays are non-null. Do not mutate inputs. Empty left yields zero. Empty right contains no values.
bad: For every left position, scan right from index zero with a nested loop and a local found flag. Stop the inner scan on the first match, then add (long)left[i] when found. No hash sets, LINQ, sorting or auxiliary collections.
good: Construct one System.Collections.Generic.HashSet<int> from right. Visit every left position, query Contains, then add (long)left[i] when found. Do not deduplicate left. No LINQ.

signature: public static long Run(int[] left, int[] right)

bad: For every left position, scan right from index zero with a nested loop and a local found flag. Stop the inner scan on the first match, then add (long)i+1 when found. No hash sets, LINQ, sorting or auxiliary collections.
good: Construct one System.Collections.Generic.HashSet<int> from right. Visit every left position, query Contains, then add (long)i+1 when found. Do not deduplicate left. No LINQ.

signature: public static long Run(int[] values, int threshold)
semantic_contract: Return the long sum of values satisfying (value > threshold), using signed int comparisons. The array is non-null; do not mutate it. Sum in long. Empty arrays or no selected values return zero.
bad: Allocate System.Collections.Generic.List<int>(values.Length). Store indices satisfying (value > threshold). Call ToArray exactly once after the scan, then iterate that index array to sum selected values in a long accumulator. No early no-match return. Do not substitute List traversal for ToArray.
good: Scan values once and sum values satisfying (value > threshold) directly into a long accumulator. No collections, arrays or LINQ; no unsigned casts.

semantic_contract: Concatenate every string in original order with no delimiter. The array and elements are non-null. Empty array returns string.Empty. Do not mutate inputs.
bad: Start with string.Empty and use repeated += to append every part in original order. No StringBuilder, string.Join, string.Concat, LINQ or other collections.
good: Use one System.Text.StringBuilder and Append to append every part in original order, then return ToString. No string.Join, LINQ or repeated +=.

semantic_contract: Concatenate nonempty strings in original order with no delimiter; skip empty strings. The array and elements are non-null. Empty array returns string.Empty. Do not mutate inputs.

semantic_contract: Join every string in original order with the literal vertical bar | between consecutive array positions, including empty positions. No leading or trailing delimiter. The array and elements are non-null. Empty array returns string.Empty. Do not mutate inputs.

good: Use one System.Text.StringBuilder and Append to append each part in original order, inserting | before every part except the first, then return ToString. No string.Join, LINQ or repeated +=.
